parsed.title: replan-findings skill missing from plugin manifest
parsed.detail: The unit introduces a replan-findings skill (docs/workflow/SKILL_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.json gains a "replan-findings" entry: "conditional replan entry; PHASE_APPEND.md holds the append contract..."), but the plugin manifest .claude-plugin/plugin.json — included as an unchanged anchor — does not list "./skills/replan-findings" in its skills array (it ends at "./skills/verification-contract", "./skills/workflow-status"). A newly added skill that is budget-tracked and referenced by the router is not registered, so it would not be discoverable/loadable via the plugin.
